about: Portability fixes for platforms v1.0.11 never compiled (fold step B6). files: each pinned to its reviewed bytes (whitespace-insensitive sha256, equivalence.py closure_digest); level 1 and the closure check compare against that instead of the shipped bytes. objects_identical: Linux TUs whose tokens change but whose objects level 3 must find identical. token_deltas: the named TUs whose portable replacement changes Linux code on purpose, allowed at level 2.

runtime-recomp/src/game/achievements.cpp.reason: libc++ (Apple, Android) has no std::atomic<std::shared_ptr>; the published snapshot is a dkr::runtime::SharedSnapshot (shared_snapshot.hpp), one mutex-guarded holder on every platform.

runtime-recomp/src/game/f3ddkr_rt64.cpp.reason: Metal builds have no enhanced-water renderer; the water_residency_rt64.hpp include is skipped under __APPLE__ (token-identical elsewhere).

runtime-recomp/src/game/mod_store.cpp.reason: libc++ (Apple, Android) has no std::atomic<std::shared_ptr>; the published snapshot is a dkr::runtime::SharedSnapshot (shared_snapshot.hpp), one mutex-guarded holder on every platform. Android links no HTTPS backend, so its curl include and backend are skipped there (the store reports itself unavailable).
